compute_forward_kinematics: compute the foot position from a given leg pose using forward kinematics
compute_inverse_kinematics: compute the leg pose from a given foot position using inverse kinematics
convert_extension_to_ankle_dist: convert a leg extension angle to the ankle-hip distance in meters
convert_ankle_dist_to_extension: convert an ankle-hip distance in meters back to the leg extension angle
review_kinematics_utils: review the Minitaur Raibert controller utility functions for forward and inverse kinematics
